Full pipeline for the StateCommute cell-cell communication analysis: CellChat processing per sample
(microglia collapsed and split by state), followed by the communication figures. Set the flags in
the first chunk to choose what is reprocessed and replotted.

## Setup

```{r setup}
options(stringsAsFactors = F)

library(Seurat)
library(CellChat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(patchwork)
library(future)

```

## Flags

```{r flags}
REPROCESS           <- FALSE
REPLOT_HEATMAPS     <- FALSE
REPLOT_INTERACTION  <- FALSE
REPLOT_CHORD        <- FALSE
REPLOT_DIFF_HEATMAP <- FALSE
REPLOT_CENTRALITY   <- TRUE
```

## Helper functions

```{r helpers}
mg_states <- c("State1","State2","State3","State4","State5")

create_cellchat_collapsed <- function(seurat_obj) {
  cells_use <- colnames(seurat_obj)
  meta_data  <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  cellchat   <- createCellChat(object   = seurat_obj@assays$RNA$data[, cells_use],
                               meta     = meta_data,
                               group.by = "annotation3_collapsed")
  cellchat   <- addMeta(cellchat, meta = meta_data)
  cellchat   <- setIdent(cellchat, ident.use = "annotation3_collapsed")
  return(cellchat)
}

create_cellchat_states <- function(seurat_obj) {
  cells_use <- colnames(seurat_obj)
  meta_data  <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  cellchat   <- createCellChat(object   = seurat_obj@assays$RNA$data[, cells_use],
                               meta     = meta_data,
                               group.by = "annotation3")
  cellchat   <- addMeta(cellchat, meta = meta_data)
  cellchat   <- setIdent(cellchat, ident.use = "annotation3")
  return(cellchat)
}

preprocess_cellchat_mouse <- function(cellchat) {
  cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.mouse
  cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
  cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
  cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, raw.use = TRUE)
  cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
  cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)
  cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP")
  return(cellchat)
}

plot_signaling_heatmap <- function(cc_list,
                                   out_pdf,
                                   pdf_width  = 8,
                                   pdf_height = 14) {
  n_pairs       <- length(cc_list) / 2
  treatment_idx <- seq(1, length(cc_list), by = 2)
  control_idx   <- seq(2, length(cc_list), by = 2)
  
  pdf(out_pdf, width = pdf_width, height = pdf_height)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
    trt_cc  <- cc_list[[treatment_idx[i]]]
    ctrl_cc <- cc_list[[control_idx[i]]]
    
    pathway.union <- unique(c(trt_cc@netP$pathways, ctrl_cc@netP$pathways))
    ht_height     <- max(3, length(pathway.union) * 0.4)
    pair_labels   <- names(cc_list)[c(treatment_idx[i], control_idx[i])]
    
    ht_pair <- lapply(pair_labels, function(label) {
      ht <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
        cc_list[[label]],
        pattern         = "all",
        signaling       = pathway.union,
        title           = label,
        width           = 5,
        height          = ht_height,
        color.heatmap   = "OrRd",
        font.size       = 12,
        font.size.title = 12
      )
      ht@column_title <- label
      return(ht)
    })
    
    combined_row <- Reduce(`+`, ht_pair)
    ComplexHeatmap::draw(
      combined_row,
      merge_legend = TRUE,
      padding      = unit(c(15, 5, 15, 5), "mm")
    )
  }
  
  dev.off()
  message("Saved: ", out_pdf)
}

filter_rare_mg_states <- function(seurat_obj, condition_name,
                                  col       = "annotation3",
                                  threshold = 0.05) {
  mg_cells <- colnames(seurat_obj)[seurat_obj[[col]][,1] %in% mg_states]
  if (length(mg_cells) == 0) return(seurat_obj)
  mg_counts <- table(seurat_obj[[col]][mg_cells, 1])
  mg_pct    <- mg_counts / sum(mg_counts)
  
  message("MG state proportions in ", condition_name, ":")
  print(round(mg_pct * 100, 1))
  
  rare_states <- names(mg_pct[mg_pct < threshold])
  if (length(rare_states) > 0) {
    message("Removing rare states (<", threshold * 100, "%): ",
            paste(rare_states, collapse = ", "))
    keep_cells <- colnames(seurat_obj)[!seurat_obj[[col]][,1] %in% rare_states]
    seurat_obj <- seurat_obj[, keep_cells]
  } else {
    message("No rare states to remove in ", condition_name)
  }
  return(seurat_obj)
}
```

## CellChat processing

```{r processing}
if (REPROCESS) {
  
  suppressWarnings(file.remove("collapsed_cellchat_processed.Rdata"))
  suppressWarnings(file.remove("pooled_cellchat_processed.Rdata"))
  suppressWarnings(file.remove("acute_cellchat_processed.Rdata"))
  
  plan(sequential)
  
  build_cc_collapsed <- function(orig_id, label) {
    message("Processing collapsed: ", label, " (", orig_id, ")")
    sub <- merge.obj.final.obj[, merge.obj.final.obj$orig.ident == orig_id]
    sub <- filter_rare_mg_states(sub, label, col = "annotation3_collapsed")
    cc  <- create_cellchat_collapsed(sub) %>% preprocess_cellchat_mouse()
    return(cc)
  }
  
  cc_OPNA <- list(
    OPNA    = build_cc_collapsed("OPNA_GD_24h",     "OPNA"),
    Control = build_cc_collapsed("OPNA_Control_24h","Control_OPNA")
  )
  cc_TBI <- list(
    TBI     = build_cc_collapsed("TBI_CCI_7d",      "TBI"),
    Control = build_cc_collapsed("TBI_Sham_7d",     "Control_TBI")
  )
  cc_VEEV <- list(
    VEEV    = build_cc_collapsed("VEEV_VEEV_7d",    "VEEV"),
    Control = build_cc_collapsed("VEEV_Mock_7d",    "Control_VEEV")
  )
  
  save(cc_OPNA, cc_TBI, cc_VEEV, file = "collapsed_cellchat_processed.Rdata")
  message("Saved: collapsed_cellchat_processed.Rdata")
  
  build_cc_states <- function(orig_id, label) {
    message("Processing states: ", label, " (", orig_id, ")")
    sub <- merge.obj.final.obj[, merge.obj.final.obj$orig.ident == orig_id]
    sub <- filter_rare_mg_states(sub, label, col = "annotation3")
    cc  <- create_cellchat_states(sub) %>% preprocess_cellchat_mouse()
    return(cc)
  }
  
  cc_OPNA_states <- list(
    OPNA    = build_cc_states("OPNA_GD_24h",     "OPNA"),
    Control = build_cc_states("OPNA_Control_24h","Control_OPNA")
  )
  cc_TBI_states <- list(
    TBI     = build_cc_states("TBI_CCI_7d",      "TBI"),
    Control = build_cc_states("TBI_Sham_7d",     "Control_TBI")
  )
  cc_VEEV_states <- list(
    VEEV    = build_cc_states("VEEV_VEEV_7d",    "VEEV"),
    Control = build_cc_states("VEEV_Mock_7d",    "Control_VEEV")
  )
  
  save(cc_OPNA_states, cc_TBI_states, cc_VEEV_states,
       file = "acute_cellchat_processed.Rdata")
  message("Saved: acute_cellchat_processed.Rdata")
  
  build_pooled_states <- function(orig_ids, label) {
    objs <- lapply(seq_along(orig_ids), function(i) {
      sub <- merge.obj.final.obj[, merge.obj.final.obj$orig.ident == orig_ids[i]]
      filter_rare_mg_states(sub, paste(label, i), col = "annotation3")
    })
    merged <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b), objs)
    merged <- JoinLayers(merged)
    create_cellchat_states(merged) %>% preprocess_cellchat_mouse()
  }
  
  cc_pooled_states <- list(
    Acute   = build_pooled_states(
      c("OPNA_GD_24h",     "TBI_CCI_7d",   "VEEV_VEEV_7d"), "Acute"),
    Control = build_pooled_states(
      c("OPNA_Control_24h","TBI_Sham_7d",  "VEEV_Mock_7d"),  "Control")
  )
  
  save(cc_pooled_states, file = "pooled_cellchat_processed.Rdata")
  message("Saved: pooled_cellchat_processed.Rdata")
  
} else {
  load("collapsed_cellchat_processed.Rdata")
  load("acute_cellchat_processed.Rdata")
  load("pooled_cellchat_processed.Rdata")
}
```

## FIGURE 3: chord diagrams — FN1 and CCL only

```{r figure-3-chord-diagrams-fn1-and-ccl-only}
if (REPLOT_CHORD) {
  
  all_mg_states <- c("State1","State2","State3","State4","State5")
  
  get_cells_use <- function(cc, states_keep) {
    all_labels  <- levels(cc@idents)
    excluded_mg <- setdiff(all_mg_states, states_keep)
    all_labels[!all_labels %in% excluded_mg]
  }
  
  chord_map <- list(
    FN1 = list(
      trt    = list(name = "OPNA",         cc = cc_OPNA_states[["OPNA"]]),
      ctrl   = list(name = "Control_OPNA", cc = cc_OPNA_states[["Control"]]),
      states = c("State1", "State2", "State3")
    ),
    CCL = list(
      trt    = list(name = "VEEV",         cc = cc_VEEV_states[["VEEV"]]),
      ctrl   = list(name = "Control_VEEV", cc = cc_VEEV_states[["Control"]]),
      states = c("State1", "State2", "State4")
    )
  )
  
  for (pathway in names(chord_map)) {
    
    trt_name   <- chord_map[[pathway]][["trt"]][["name"]]
    ctrl_name  <- chord_map[[pathway]][["ctrl"]][["name"]]
    cc_trt     <- chord_map[[pathway]][["trt"]][["cc"]]
    cc_ctrl    <- chord_map[[pathway]][["ctrl"]][["cc"]]
    states_use <- chord_map[[pathway]][["states"]]
    
    cells_trt  <- get_cells_use(cc_trt,  states_use)
    cells_ctrl <- get_cells_use(cc_ctrl, states_use)
    
    out_name <- fig(paste0("Acute.", pathway, ".chord.pdf"))
    
    pdf(out_name, width = 16, height = 8)
    par(mfrow = c(1, 2), xpd = TRUE, cex = 0.9, mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))
    
    tryCatch({
      netVisual_aggregate(
        cc_trt,
        signaling      = pathway,
        layout         = "chord",
        sources.use    = cells_trt,
        targets.use    = cells_trt,
        remove.isolate = TRUE,
        signaling.name = trt_name
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("  No interactions for ", trt_name, " / ", pathway)
      plot.new()
      text(0.5, 0.5, paste0(trt_name, "\nNo interactions"),
           cex = 1.2, col = "grey40", adj = c(0.5, 0.5))
    })
    
    tryCatch({
      netVisual_aggregate(
        cc_ctrl,
        signaling      = pathway,
        layout         = "chord",
        sources.use    = cells_ctrl,
        targets.use    = cells_ctrl,
        remove.isolate = TRUE,
        signaling.name = ctrl_name
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("  No interactions for ", ctrl_name, " / ", pathway)
      plot.new()
      text(0.5, 0.5, paste0(ctrl_name, "\nNo interactions"),
           cex = 1.2, col = "grey40", adj = c(0.5, 0.5))
    })
    
    dev.off()
    message("Saved: ", out_name)
  }
}
```

## FIGURE 4: MG differential heatmaps side by side

```{r figure-4-mg-differential-heatmaps-side-b}
if (REPLOT_DIFF_HEATMAP) {
  
  extract_mg_centrality <- function(cc, condition_name, score = "outdeg") {
    lapply(names(cc@netP$centr), function(pw) {
      centr     <- cc@netP$centr[[pw]]
      mg_scores <- centr[[score]][names(centr[[score]]) %in% mg_states]
      if (length(mg_scores) == 0) return(NULL)
      data.frame(
        pathway   = pw,
        condition = condition_name,
        cell_type = names(mg_scores),
        score     = as.numeric(mg_scores),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }) %>% bind_rows()
  }
  
  score_df <- lapply(names(object.list.states), function(cond) {
    out <- extract_mg_centrality(object.list.states[[cond]], cond, "outdeg")
    ins <- extract_mg_centrality(object.list.states[[cond]], cond, "indeg")
    bind_rows(out, ins)
  }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    group_by(pathway, condition, cell_type) %>%
    summarise(total_score = sum(score), .groups = "drop")
  
  comparisons_trt <- list(
    OPNA = c(treatment = "OPNA",  control = "Control_OPNA"),
    VEEV = c(treatment = "VEEV",  control = "Control_VEEV"),
    TBI  = c(treatment = "TBI",   control = "Control_TBI")
  )
  
  diff_trt <- lapply(names(comparisons_trt), function(comp) {
    trt  <- comparisons_trt[[comp]]["treatment"]
    ctrl <- comparisons_trt[[comp]]["control"]
    trt_df  <- score_df %>% filter(condition == trt)  %>%
      rename(trt_score  = total_score) %>% select(-condition)
    ctrl_df <- score_df %>% filter(condition == ctrl) %>%
      rename(ctrl_score = total_score) %>% select(-condition)
    full_join(trt_df, ctrl_df, by = c("pathway", "cell_type")) %>%
      mutate(
        trt_score  = ifelse(is.na(trt_score),  0, trt_score),
        ctrl_score = ifelse(is.na(ctrl_score), 0, ctrl_score),
        diff       = trt_score - ctrl_score,
        comparison = comp
      )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  pathway_diff_trt <- diff_trt %>%
    group_by(pathway, comparison) %>%
    summarise(mean_diff = mean(diff), .groups = "drop")
  
  pathway_rank <- pathway_diff_trt %>%
    group_by(pathway) %>%
    summarise(max_abs_diff = max(abs(mean_diff)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(max_abs_diff))
  
  write.csv(pathway_rank,
            file = fig("Acute.MG.Pathway.Differential.Ranked.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(diff_trt,
            file = fig("Acute.MG.Pathway.Differential.Full.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  top_n     <- 30
  top_paths <- pathway_rank %>%
    filter(max_abs_diff > 0) %>%
    head(top_n) %>%
    pull(pathway)
  
  mat_trt <- do.call(cbind, lapply(names(comparisons_trt), function(comp) {
    sub  <- pathway_diff_trt %>% filter(comparison == comp, pathway %in% top_paths)
    vals <- setNames(rep(0, length(top_paths)), top_paths)
    vals[sub$pathway] <- sub$mean_diff
    vals
  }))
  colnames(mat_trt) <- names(comparisons_trt)
  rownames(mat_trt) <- top_paths
  
  state_control_pairs <- list(
    State3 = "Control_OPNA",
    State4 = "Control_VEEV",
    State5 = "Control_TBI"
  )
  
  mat_state <- do.call(cbind, lapply(names(state_control_pairs), function(st) {
    matched_ctrl <- state_control_pairs[[st]]
    st_all <- score_df %>%
      filter(cell_type == st) %>%
      group_by(pathway) %>%
      summarise(st_score = mean(total_score), .groups = "drop")
    ctrl_baseline <- score_df %>%
      filter(condition == matched_ctrl) %>%
      group_by(pathway) %>%
      summarise(baseline = mean(total_score), .groups = "drop")
    diff_st <- full_join(st_all, ctrl_baseline, by = "pathway") %>%
      mutate(
        st_score = ifelse(is.na(st_score), 0, st_score),
        baseline = ifelse(is.na(baseline), 0, baseline),
        diff     = st_score - baseline
      )
    vals <- setNames(rep(0, length(top_paths)), top_paths)
    matched <- diff_st %>% filter(pathway %in% top_paths)
    vals[matched$pathway] <- matched$diff
    vals
  }))
  
  colnames(mat_state) <- c("State3", "State4", "State5")
  rownames(mat_state) <- top_paths
  
  abs_max <- max(abs(mat_trt), abs(mat_state))
  
  col_shared <- colorRamp2(c(-abs_max, 0, abs_max),
                           c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))
  
  ht_trt <- Heatmap(
    mat_trt,
    name            = "Mean diff",
    col             = col_shared,
    cluster_rows    = TRUE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_row_names  = TRUE,
    row_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 12),
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
    column_title    = "Treatment vs Control",
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
    rect_gp         = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
    cell_fun        = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      val <- mat_trt[i, j]
      if (abs(val) > abs_max * 0.3) {
        grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", val), x, y,
                  gp = gpar(fontsize = 9,
                            col = ifelse(abs(val) > abs_max * 0.6,
                                         "white", "black")))
      }
    },
    width  = unit(5, "cm"),
    height = unit(top_n * 0.55, "cm")
  )
  
  ht_state <- Heatmap(
    mat_state,
    name            = "Mean diff",
    col             = col_shared,
    cluster_rows    = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_row_names  = TRUE,
    row_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 12),
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
    column_title    = "Activated States vs Control",
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
    rect_gp         = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
    cell_fun        = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      val <- mat_state[i, j]
      if (abs(val) > abs_max * 0.3) {
        grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", val), x, y,
                  gp = gpar(fontsize = 9,
                            col = ifelse(abs(val) > abs_max * 0.6,
                                         "white", "black")))
      }
    },
    width  = unit(6, "cm"),
    height = unit(top_n * 0.55, "cm")
  )
  
  pdf(fig("Acute.MG.Pathway.Differential.Heatmap.pdf"),
      width  = 20,
      height = max(10, top_n * 0.6))
  draw(ht_trt + ht_state,
       merge_legend = TRUE,
       padding      = unit(c(10, 10, 10, 30), "mm"))
  dev.off()
  message("Saved: ", fig("Acute.MG.Pathway.Differential.Heatmap.pdf"))
}
```

## FIGURE 5: centrality bar plots — FN1 and CCL

```{r figure-5-centrality-bar-plots-fn1-and-cc}
if (REPLOT_CENTRALITY) {
  
  extract_centr <- function(cc, cond, pathway, states_keep) {
    if (!pathway %in% names(cc@netP$centr)) return(NULL)
    centr <- cc@netP$centr[[pathway]]
    mg    <- intersect(states_keep, names(centr$outdeg))
    if (length(mg) == 0) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      pathway   = pathway,
      condition = cond,
      cell_type = mg,
      outdeg    = centr$outdeg[mg],
      indeg     = centr$indeg[mg],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  centrality_map <- list(
    FN1 = list(
      conditions = c("OPNA", "Control_OPNA"),
      states     = c("State1", "State2", "State3"),
      cc_list    = list(
        OPNA         = cc_OPNA_states[["OPNA"]],
        Control_OPNA = cc_OPNA_states[["Control"]]
      )
    ),
    CCL = list(
      conditions = c("VEEV", "Control_VEEV"),
      states     = c("State1", "State2", "State4"),
      cc_list    = list(
        VEEV         = cc_VEEV_states[["VEEV"]],
        Control_VEEV = cc_VEEV_states[["Control"]]
      )
    ),
    ApoE = list(
      conditions = c("TBI", "Control_TBI"),        
      states     = c("State1", "State2", "State5"),
      state_map  = list(
        TBI         = c("State5"),
        Control_TBI = c("State1", "State2")
      ),
      cc_list    = list(
        TBI         = cc_TBI_states[["TBI"]],      
        Control_TBI = cc_TBI_states[["Control"]]    
      )
    ),
    SPP1 = list(
      conditions = c("OPNA", "TBI", "VEEV",
                     "Control_OPNA", "Control_TBI", "Control_VEEV"),  # fixed duplicate Control_TBI
      states     = c("State1", "State2", "State3", "State4", "State5"),
      cc_list    = list(
        OPNA         = cc_OPNA_states[["OPNA"]],    # fixed: was all cc_VEEV_states
        TBI          = cc_TBI_states[["TBI"]],
        VEEV         = cc_VEEV_states[["VEEV"]],
        Control_OPNA = cc_OPNA_states[["Control"]],
        Control_TBI  = cc_TBI_states[["Control"]],
        Control_VEEV = cc_VEEV_states[["Control"]]
      )
    )
  )
    
  
  for (pathway in names(centrality_map)) {
    
    conds_use  <- centrality_map[[pathway]][["conditions"]]
    states_use <- centrality_map[[pathway]][["states"]]
    cc_list    <- centrality_map[[pathway]][["cc_list"]]
    
    centr_df <- lapply(conds_use, function(cond) {
      states_for_cond <- if (!is.null(centrality_map[[pathway]][["state_map"]])) {
        centrality_map[[pathway]][["state_map"]][[cond]]
      } else {
        states_use
      }
      extract_centr(cc_list[[cond]], cond, pathway, states_for_cond)
    }) %>%
      bind_rows()
    
    if (nrow(centr_df) == 0) {
      message("No centrality data for ", pathway)
      next
    }
    
    centr_df <- centr_df %>%
      mutate(
        total     = outdeg + indeg,
        group     = ifelse(grepl("^Control", condition), "Control", "Disease"),
        condition = factor(condition, levels = conds_use),
        cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = states_use)
      )
    
    p <- ggplot(centr_df, aes(x = cell_type, y = total, fill = condition)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
               width = 0.7) +
      facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_x") +
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
      labs(x     = NULL,
           y     = "Total centrality (outdeg + indeg)",
           fill  = "Condition",
           title = pathway) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
      theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
            axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
            strip.text   = element_text(size = 12),
            plot.title   = element_text(size = 13),
            legend.text  = element_text(size = 11),
            legend.title = element_text(size = 12))
    
    out_pdf <- fig(paste0("Acute.CentralityBar.", pathway, ".pdf"))
    pdf(out_pdf, width = 8, height = 5)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
    message("Saved: ", out_pdf)
  }
}
```
